dedupe_keys.name: recybat24 lithium ion battery images and experiment configurations

description: The University of Calabria publishes RecyBat24, images of lithium-ion batteries for recycling research. The deposit covers pouch, prismatic and cylindrical shapes, with packages for classification and segmentation and a README describing experiment configurations. The documentation names YOLOX, RTMDet, RT-DETR and FastSAM baselines, but the models themselves are external tools. The Zenodo files are free under CC BY 4.0. These images can help evaluate visual sorting components used in battery-recycling plant simulations or logistics planning. No directly related catalogue record was identified. A caveat is that classification on the published images does not establish throughput, contamination rates or safety in a live sorting line. Image balance, acquisition conditions and label quality need file-level inspection before transferring results. The public metadata, file list and small README were checked; image archives and model packages were not downloaded or run.
